lines: Q: What's the hardest part of meals for you? Or something else.
A: We never know what to tell Rekha about dinner, and groceries keep running out.

Q: Which apps do you order groceries on: Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart, BigBasket or Amazon? If you sign me in, I'll read your past orders to learn what your home buys and how often, so the plan and the shopping list fit you from the first week, and I can fill the cart for you. Nothing is ordered without your yes.
A: Zepto mainly, Blinkit if Zepto doesn't have it. And later on the sign-in thing.
Q: Which is your main app, and which do you use when something isn't there?
A: Zepto is the main one. Blinkit only when Zepto doesn't have something.
Q: I have Nikhil (30) and Tanya (29) eating at home. Anyone else who eats at home, or anyone who doesn't?
A: Nope, just the two of us. No kids, no one else.
Q: Rekha cooks Mon-Fri: Lunch and Dinner at 10am. Is that right, and does the cook come for any other meals?
A: Yeah that's right, lunch and dinner in one go at 10am. She's done in an hour and a half and leaves.
Q: Is the cook short of time, say off to the next house, so only a dish or two in the morning?
A: She has an hour and a half, so she does the full lunch and dinner. Not rushed.
A: Lunch is usually rice, a sabzi, and chicken or dal. Dinner is roti with a sabzi and chicken or paneer.
Q: On Saturday and Sunday, when the cook doesn't come, who cooks? Or is a meal eaten out?
A: Saturday lunch we eat out, Saturday dinner and Sunday lunch we order in.
A: Sunday dinner Tanya cooks something simple. Breakfast I make every day.
Q: What did the adults have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: I had eggs every morning — scrambled or fried. Tanya does oats or a smoothie, sometimes toast.
Q: The adults' lunch over the past week?
A: Weekdays it's whatever Rekha packs — chicken curry or dal, rice, a sabzi, salad. Paneer when not chicken.
A: Weekends we eat out or order in, so varied.
A: btw Rekha's timing changed, she comes at 11 now not 10
Q: The adults' dinner over the past week?
A: Weekdays same as lunch but with roti instead of rice — chicken or paneer with a sabzi, sometimes dal.
A: Weekends we order in or Tanya cooks something simple on Sunday night.
Q: Is anyone on a diet? High protein, low carb, diabetic, anything a doctor asked for.
A: Yeah I'm on high protein, gym. Tanya's not on anything.
Q: Any food rules for the house? Veg, egg or non-veg days, fasting days, allergies, a dish someone won't touch.
A: Tanya doesn't eat red meat or mutton. Chicken, fish, eggs are fine for both of us.
A: No fasting or allergies otherwise.
Q: How often do you order in, and on which days?
A: Saturday dinner and Sunday lunch, every week.
Q: Does anything come on a subscription, like Country Delight or a milkman?
A: No subscriptions for anything.
